app.name: Lectern
app.tagline: A local workbench for chat and OCR.

common.loadFailed: Lectern didn't answer. Check that `lectern serve` is still running, then reload.

errors.noToken: Open Lectern from the link that `lectern serve` printed. That link contains the access key this page needs.

below_minimum.name: Below minimum
below_minimum.summary: No usable GPU. Models run on the processor: it works, but slowly.

minimum.name: Minimum
minimum.summary: A 4B chat model. One model sits on the GPU at a time, so OCR and chat take turns.

recommended.name: Recommended
recommended.summary: A 9B chat model. OCR and chat swap on the GPU while a document is processed.

comfortable.name: Comfortable
comfortable.summary: Larger models, and chat and OCR can stay loaded together.

firstRun.title: Set up Lectern
firstRun.intro: Lectern runs every model on this computer. First, here's what it found, and the chat model that suits it.
firstRun.notEnoughDisk: There isn't enough free disk space for this model, plus 1 GB to spare. Free some space, then reload.
firstRun.sandboxFound: {{runtime}} {{version}} is running. Lectern will use it to run calculation scripts in isolation.
firstRun.sandboxStopped: {{runtime}} is installed but not running. Start it to let Lectern run calculation scripts.
firstRun.sandboxMissing: Neither Podman nor Docker is installed.
firstRun.sandboxWhy: Without one, Lectern can't run calculation scripts, and marks exact numbers as not computed. Everything else works.

modelsPage.title: Models & memory
modelsPage.onFirstUse: Only the chat model is downloaded during setup. The others download the first time they're needed.
